epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full stack local startup time from >5 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack local deployment
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization setup for this epic, I want to configure a docker-compose.yml file, so that the entire product stack can be started with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a repository without a docker-compose.yml
When a developer runs `docker-compose up`
Then the backend and frontend services start successfully and a health-check endpoint is accessible on the host machine.
Given a running stack started via docker-compose
When a developer curls the health-check endpoint
Then the system responds with an HTTP 200 indicating all services are healthy.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce manual service startup commands from >3 to 1

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to update or remove an outdated material from >5 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Implement frontend UI capabilities to invoke existing update and delete APIs for epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Add update and delete material capabilities to frontend UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add edit and delete actions, so that users can maintain the catalog directly from the interface.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system
When a user clicks the edit button and saves changes
Then the frontend calls the correct existing API endpoint and updates the displayed catalog list.
Given an existing material in the system
When a user clicks the delete button and confirms the action
Then the material is removed from the catalog list and a deletion request is sent to the API.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce UI workflow time for deleting materials from >2 mins to <5 seconds

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access success rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Enforce authentication for accessing the catalog and modifying materials.

slices.title: Implement authentication guard for catalog access
slices.jtbd: When implementing the security layer for this epic, I want to add an authentication check, so that unauthenticated users are blocked from viewing or changing materials.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to create or modify a material
Then their access attempt is rejected and they are redirected to authentication.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase endpoint protection coverage from 0% to 100% of restricted routes
